title: Write an exact seven-word sentence with two required words
rationale: Exact-length constraints govern UI copy, subtitles, and constrained decoding; off-by-one additions are a frequent instruction failure that breaks fixed-slot layouts.

prompt.content: You are a terse assistant. Output only the requested sentence; no explanation, no quotation marks.
Write exactly one sentence of exactly seven words. The sentence must include the words 'silent' and 'river'. Output only the sentence and nothing else.

notes: Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, whitespace-token word count with a trailing newline allowed. Brittleness: a hyphenated compound counts as one word and a word with attached punctuation counts as one word, so an eight-word sentence fails even when the content is right.
